requests.title: Подготовка, разбег и торможение
requests.prompt: Animation reference for the exact stylized wooden stone-forehead boar in the supplied first frame, a four-legged game creature. Preserve the same ivory forehead shield and spiral emblem, tusks, cloven stone hooves, wood anatomy, olive foliage, proportions and painted materials. Exactly one creature, four legs throughout. Same neutral studio ground, soft light and locked camera as the input. One continuous full-body shot, feet always inside frame, no cuts, camera movement, zoom, text or UI. Clear physically grounded weight transfer, articulated shoulder blades and hips, planted support hooves, inertial head and foliage follow-through. No body morphing or stretched limbs. Only very faint contact dust if needed; no magic, trails, telegraphs or added sound. Six-second motion study. The boar starts on the RIGHT facing LEFT with the open floor in front. 0.0-1.0 seconds: body remains in its starting location, braces on three hooves, scrapes the near FRONT hoof BACKWARDS across the ground exactly TWICE, briefly lifting and replacing it between scrapes. Both scrapes are clearly visible. Chest subtly rocks with each scrape, shoulders compress, head lowers ready to ram; no frozen hold. At 1.0 second plant that hoof, hindquarters push forcefully and the boar launches LEFT. 1.0-2.2 seconds: explosive accelerating quadrupedal gallop along a perfectly straight path across the available floor, powerful alternating reach and gather of the front legs, hind legs propel the heavy body, head remains low. Stay inside the left edge of frame. 2.2-2.8 seconds: plant the forelegs ahead, lower the hips and brake to a stop with one short heavy skid; hooves grip rather than skate throughout the run. 2.8-6.0 seconds: chest and head overshoot then settle, two small weight-correcting steps and breathing, return to a grounded low ready stance. Do not turn around or perform a second attack. The initial two-hoof-scrape warning and heavy launch are the most important parts.
